data.name: Asterforge x Singtel: RCA close-out and SD-WAN phase one

segments.speaker: Demo Team Member 02
segments.text: Thanks both for making time. First item: did the team get through the RCA for the October outage at the Tuas plant?

segments.speaker: Demo Avery Tan 001
segments.text: We did. We reviewed it on Friday and we're accepting the RCA as written. The fibre cut and the failover timings match what our own logs show.

segments.speaker: Demo Sam Lee 001
segments.text: Agreed. The only follow-up from my side is the alerting delay, but the corrective actions in section four cover it.

segments.speaker: Demo Team Member 02
segments.text: Great, I'll record the RCA as accepted and close the service ticket. Next, SD-WAN. Where did you land on phase one?

segments.speaker: Demo Avery Tan 001
segments.text: Phase one is two branches: Johor Bahru and the Penang warehouse. We want those cut over first, then we'll look at the rest of the sites.

segments.speaker: Demo Sam Lee 001
segments.text: From the network side, the requirement is no application downtime during cutover. We can do weekend windows for both branches.

segments.speaker: Demo Team Member 02
segments.text: Understood. I'll send a phase-one proposal for the two branches with a weekend cutover plan by the end of next week.

segments.speaker: Demo Sam Lee 001
segments.text: One more thing. Does Singtel offer 24x7 security monitoring? Our auditors keep asking for evidence that someone is watching the network around the clock.

segments.speaker: Demo Sam Lee 001
segments.text: Specifically we need audit evidence: monthly reports and incident logs we can hand to the auditors.

segments.speaker: Demo Team Member 02
segments.text: We do, through our managed security operations service. It includes monthly compliance reporting. I can share a short overview.

segments.speaker: Demo Avery Tan 001
segments.text: Send the overview, but no commitment yet. We might consider monitoring in Q1 2027 once phase one is stable and next year's budget is confirmed.

segments.speaker: Demo Team Member 02
segments.text: That works. To recap: RCA accepted, phase-one proposal for two branches from me next week, and a security monitoring overview for Q1 planning. Thanks both.
